answer: Give every new agent an anchored identity: it posts a refundable stake and can only act through a public record of its past work. Peers quietly whisper attestations about each other's reliability, and those whispers accumulate into a reef of reputation that no single actor can fake quickly. A newcomer starts in shallow water with tiny limits and only earns deeper access as its anchored history grows; splitting into many fake identities means funding each one's stake and track record separately, which makes sybil attacks expensive and slow.
